article.headline: Hines puts up 19 in SE Louisiana's 75-65 victory against Grambling
article.description: — Sam Hines Jr. had 19 points in SE Louisiana's 75-65 win against Grambling on Monday night.
article.linkText: Hines puts up 19 in SE Louisiana's 75-65 victory against Grambling
article.story: GRAMBLING, La. -- — Sam Hines Jr. had 19 points in SE Louisiana's 75-65 win against Grambling on Monday night. Hines added five rebounds for the Lions (5-6, 0-1 Southland Conference). Kam Burton scored 18 points while shooting 6 for 10 from beyond the arc and added five rebounds. Jakevion Buckley had 13 points and shot 5 of 6 from the field and 3 for 5 from the line. The Tigers (2-7) were led in scoring by Mikale Stevenson and Chilaydrien Newton, who each scored 16 points. Kintavious Dozier finished with 11 points and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
